full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
First Session
Meeting Number - 3
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
2082 Chaitra 23, Monday
1:00 PM
1. Nomination to the Business Advisory Committee
The Honorable Speaker will inform about the nomination of Honorable Members to the Business Advisory Committee.
2. Formation of the Rules Drafting Committee
Honorable Kabindra Burlakoti will present a proposal stating "Let the Rules Drafting Committee of the House of Representatives be formed," along with the list of Honorable Members to be included in the committee.
The following Honorable Members will support the said proposal:-
(1) Honorable Sita Thapaliya
(2) Honorable Ganesh Singh Thaguna
(3) Honorable Yuvaraj Dulal
(4) Honorable Dhubraj Rai
(5) Honorable Bharat Giri
(6) Honorable Pushpa Kumari Chaudhary
3. Business related to Ordinances
The Honorable Home Minister Sudhan Gurung will present a proposal stating "Let the following ordinances be approved."
(a) "Voter List (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2082"
(b) "House of Representatives Member Election (First Amendment) Ordinance, 2082"
(c) "Nepal Special Service (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2082"
4. Condolence Motion
The Honorable Speaker will present a condolence motion on the demise of former member Ramchandra Bhattarai.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
